phone.changelog: v3.9.3: ad blocker for the phone player. Movie mirrors were loading YouTube ad popups when you opened a title — those are now blocked at the network level. No more YouTube ads.

tv.changelog: v3.17.2 fix: direct streams now play through AJO's relay on the in-app player — the phone/web player couldn't send the required header and was erroring on direct streams. Native hardware player unchanged.
